from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single month's construction statistics extracted from a specific report."""
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the containing report was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve precedence conflicts")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The specific month the data represents (YYYY-MM)")
    units_under_construction: float | None = Field(description="Total units under construction at end of period, in thousands")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Total completions at seasonally adjusted annual rate, in thousands")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted monthly metrics from a single document."""
    construction_metrics: list[MonthlyConstructionMetric]
